---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

**Problem:** Describe the problem this feature would solve.

**Who benefits:** Who would use this feature? (e.g., live performers, studio users, etc.)

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered alternative approaches? What are they?

## Examples

Are there similar features in other software that inspired this request?

## Implementation Considerations

If you have ideas about implementation:
- Which components would be affected?
- Are there potential challenges?
- Would this require configuration changes?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals (live performance control)
- [ ] I have considered backward compatibility
